messages:
Ivy C: hi all, i'm ivy — started today on growth. need staging console access to validate the search-experiments flags and want to understand who owns emergency rollbacks for experiments if something spikes :wave:
Ops-Leo: hey @Ivy welcome! i can grant staging flag admin. emergency rollbacks are usually handled by the oncall infra engineer + product owner. for prod there's a defined runbook. do you just need staging or prod-readonly too?
Ivy C: staging only for now. curious if the staging toggles have the same rollback UI as prod (instant rollback button)
Ops-Leo: staging has the same UI but with fewer guardrails. there is an "Abort Run" and "Revert Override" action. use the Activity tab to see who triggered changes.
Ivy C: perfect. any approvals needed to get staging admin?
AccessBot: Access request received: user=ivy.c scope=flags-admin-staging ttl=36h. Pending approval from ops-leo.
Ops-Leo: approved, granting now. command:
```
accessctl grant --user ivy.c --role flags-admin-staging --ttl 36h --reason "onboarding: search experiments"
```

AccessBot: Access granted: user=ivy.c role=flags-admin-staging ttl=36h actor=ops-leo id=evt_1781112222
Ivy C: got it, i can see the override panel and Activity tab. thanks!
Sec-Maya: quick security note: do not perform rollback by regenerating tokens or changing service credentials. use the Console rollback controls or the API. also, include a short incident note in the experiment ticket if you rollback.
Product-James: i'm the PO for search-experiments. if you see anything odd (CTR drop or error spike) ping me + Ops-Leo and we'll evaluate immediate rollback vs gradual ramp-down.
Ivy C: good to know. one more q: if i need help during a rollback, is there a recommended channel or a page in the runbook?
Ops-Leo: ping #release-war-room for a page and call the infra oncall. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/flag-rollbacks. Also keep the rollout ticket updated with reasoning and screenshots.
People-Ops: welcome Ivy! if you want a buddy for your first rollback test in staging, i can connect you with someone from product to pair with.
Ivy C: appreciate that — i'll take a buddy. planning to run a small 5% test this afternoon, will post results and tag James + Leo. thanks everyone :tada:
